stories.title: Bank unions call off 3-day strike after assurances, IBA to study demands

en.title: Bank unions call off 3-day strike after assurances, IBA to study demands
en.summary: Indian bank unions have cancelled a planned three-day strike after receiving assurances. The Indian Banks' Association agreed to examine the unions' demands through further discussions.

stories.title: IndiGo A321 suffers tail strike in Bengaluru

en.title: IndiGo A321 suffers tail strike in Bengaluru
en.summary: An IndiGo aircraft experienced a tail strike incident in Bengaluru. The A321 aircraft was involved in the ground-level accident at the airport.

stories.title: Two dead after avalanche hits Himlung Himal base camp in Nepal; 10 missing

en.title: Two dead after avalanche hits Himlung Himal base camp in Nepal; 10 missing
en.summary: An avalanche struck a base camp at Himlung Himal in Nepal, killing two people and leaving ten others missing. The incident occurred at the mountainous location.

stories.title: Bank unions defer three-day nationwide strike after ‘understandings reached’ with IBA

en.title: Bank unions defer three-day nationwide strike after 'understandings reached' with IBA
en.summary: Indian bank unions have postponed a planned three-day strike after reaching preliminary understandings with the Indian Banks' Association. A committee will be formed to discuss making remaining Saturdays holidays.

stories.title: 3-Day Bank Strike Deferred After Meeting Between Association, Unions

en.title: 3-Day Bank Strike Deferred After Meeting Between Association, Unions
en.summary: A planned three-day strike involving approximately 800,000 bank officers and employees has been postponed following discussions between the banking association and unions.

stories.title: 2 Children Killed, Their Mothers Injured After Water Tank Collapses In Gurugram

en.title: 2 Children Killed, Their Mothers Injured After Water Tank Collapses In Gurugram
en.summary: Two children died and their mothers were injured when a water tank collapsed in Gurugram. The tank had been completed on September 25.

stories.title: Bank unions defer 3-day strike after talks, was set to start today

en.title: Bank unions defer 3-day strike after talks, was set to start today
en.summary: Bank unions have postponed a three-day strike that was scheduled to begin following negotiations.

stories.title: 3 killed, 4 injured after fight erupts into gunfire at Detroit strip club in US

en.title: 3 killed, 4 injured after fight erupts into gunfire at Detroit strip club in US
en.summary: Three men were killed and four others wounded in a shooting at a Detroit strip club early Sunday morning. The incident resulted from a confrontation between patrons, and police are investigating the case.

stories.title: IndiGo Flight Suffers Tail Strike In Bengaluru, Airline Blames Weather

en.title: IndiGo Flight Suffers Tail Strike In Bengaluru, Airline Blames Weather
en.summary: An IndiGo aircraft experienced a tail strike incident in Bengaluru. The airline attributed the occurrence to gusty weather conditions.

stories.title: 4 killed, 9 injured as under-construction building collapses in Ambala village

en.title: 4 killed, 9 injured as under-construction building collapses in Ambala village
en.summary: A building under construction collapsed in an Ambala village, resulting in four deaths and nine injuries.

stories.title: 15,000 runs for Kohli! Virat joins Sachin Tendulkar in ODI record book

en.title: 15,000 runs for Kohli! Virat joins Sachin Tendulkar in ODI record book
en.summary: Virat Kohli reached 15,002 ODI runs across 315 matches, joining Sachin Tendulkar in the record books. He has scored 54 centuries and 80 fifties with a batting average of 58.83.

stories.title: Asian Games: Athletics leads India’s seven-medal haul, three boxers assure medals

en.title: Asian Games: Athletics leads India's seven-medal haul, three boxers assure medals
en.summary: India won seven medals at the Asian Games 2026, primarily from athletics and squash, with boxers securing three additional medals through semifinal victories.

stories.title: J Infratech files IPO papers; eyes Rs 600 cr via fresh issue

en.title: J Infratech files IPO papers; eyes Rs 600 cr via fresh issue
en.summary: J Infratech Ltd, a Haryana-based infrastructure company established in 2005, has filed preliminary IPO documents for a Rs 600 crore offering comprising fresh shares and promoter sales. The funds will be used for working capital, debt repayment, and other corporate purposes.
